Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Product-focused frontend engineer who builds accessible, testable React applications and collaborates closely with design and backend teams.

Senior Frontend Engineer, Orbit Health — Mar 2022 - Present
Led frontend development for a telehealth web portal, shipping components and pages used by clinicians and patients. Implemented a shared component library in TypeScript and React, improving developer velocity by reducing duplicated UI code across three product teams. Built responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS and enforced design tokens for consistent theming. Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest to increase test coverage of critical patient workflows. Used Jira to track features, bugs, and releases, coordinating sprint planning and cross-team dependencies.

React Developer, Nykaa — Dec 2012 - Feb 2022
Developed consumer-facing e-commerce pages and promotional experiences using React and component-based patterns. Rewrote legacy product listing and PDP modules in React with Tailwind CSS for responsive styling and modular utility classes, which helped reduce CSS bundle size and speed up page render. Collaborated with UX to refine interaction states and accessibility. Maintained styles and layout with CSS and ensured regressions were covered by Jest tests. Tracked tasks and releases through Jira and participated in grooming and retrospective ceremonies.

Skills: React, TypeScript, Jest, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Jira

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
